-- Precondition definitions

  True
  -- !benchmark @end precond

-- !benchmark @end auxcode

-- Main function definitions
def compute_gcd (a : UInt64) (b : UInt64) (h_precond : compute_gcd_precond a b) : UInt64 :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  UInt64.ofNat (Nat.gcd a.toNat b.toNat)
  -- !benchmark @end code

-- Postcondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def compute_gcd_postcond (a : UInt64) (b : UInt64) (result : UInt64) (h_precond : compute_gcd_precond a b) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start postcond
  result.toNat = Nat.gcd (UInt64.toNat a) (UInt64.toNat b)
  -- !benchmark @end postcond

-- !benchmark @start lemma
lemma gcd_toNat_lt_uint64_size (a b : UInt64) :
    Nat.gcd a.toNat b.toNat < UInt64.size := by
  by_cases ha : a.toNat = 0
  · simpa [ha] using UInt64.toNat_lt b
  · have ha_pos : 0 < a.toNat := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero ha
    have hle : Nat.gcd a.toNat b.toNat ≤ a.toNat :=
      Nat.le_of_dvd ha_pos (Nat.gcd_dvd_left a.toNat b.toNat)
    exact lt_of_le_of_lt hle (UInt64.toNat_lt a)

lemma UInt64_toNat_ofNat_eq_of_lt {n : Nat} (h : n < UInt64.size) :
    (UInt64.ofNat n).toNat = n := by
  change (OfNat.ofNat n : UInt64).toNat = n
  rw [UInt64.toNat_ofNat]
  exact Nat.mod_eq_of_lt h
-- !benchmark @end lemma

-- Proof content
theorem compute_gcd_postcond_satisfied (a : UInt64) (b : UInt64) (h_precond : compute_gcd_precond a b) :
    compute_gcd_postcond a b (compute_gcd a b h_precond) h_precond := by
  -- !benchmark @start proof
  unfold compute_gcd compute_gcd_postcond
  exact UInt64_toNat_ofNat_eq_of_lt (gcd_toNat_lt_uint64_size a b)
  -- !benchmark @end proof
